searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, applications.json, and life/PIPELINE.md's applied/closed list (Notion BDR, Stripe New Grad PM Accelerator, Disney APM, Tuck Business Bridge, IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures APM, TikTok APM, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, Adobe x3, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July cohort, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM, Google+Capital One calendar hold) plus the Sept 22 additions (Google/Capital One still unapplied, UMich CogSci Honors deadline Oct 1, Chicago Booth/HBS/Darden MBA nurtures) -- excluded regardless of egress state since none are the target 6 role families at new-grad level. Checked the graduation-date conflict this run's prompt flagged as 'genuinely unsettled Aug-Dec 2026': life/PROFILE.md now reads 'Graduation: December 2026 -- SETTLED by Dom 2026-08-04,' matching morning-briefing/profile.md exactly -- no live conflict, the scheduler prompt's framing predates that resolution. Tested WebFetch directly against www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs, job-boards.greenhouse.io, boards-api.greenhouse.io, and api.ashbyhq.com -- all four returned EGRESS_BLOCKED. WebSearch itself works and surfaced a live Anthropic 'Applied AI Architect' req (5406982008, Startups team) plus its General Catalyst/Accel mirror listings, but the search snippet itself states the role wants 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Architect/SE/FDE/founder-led sales) -- a hard dealbreaker per profile.md and hunt.md's eligibility bar -- and per hunt.md's honesty rule #2, nothing can be verified as open-and-eligible from a snippet alone when the page itself can't be fetched. This is the identical WebFetch-egress-blocked failure mode logged on every hunt commit back through at least 2026-09-01 (one entry traces the start to ~2026-08-18) -- now 5+ consecutive weeks with zero exception. Zero verified opportunities is the correct, honest output again. Flagging upstream for a human: src/hunt-store.js readHuntResults() returns null whenever opportunities.length is 0 regardless of an honest generatedAt/searchLog, so every one of these zero-result days has been silently falling through to src/brief.js's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-gated paid opportunity-hunter (confirmed present as a GitHub Actions secret in .github/workflows/morning-briefing.yml) rather than to the free Google News fallback the design doc describes as the last resort. That means the 'runs on the subscription, no API cost' design intent for opportunity-hunting has likely been silently replaced by daily paid Anthropic API calls for the entire length of this outage -- a cost with no visible marker anywhere in the sent email. This needs a human to look at (a) why the sandboxed hunt session's network egress policy blocks WebFetch across every domain tested while WebSearch is unaffected, and (b) whether hunt-store.js should short-circuit brief.js's fallback chain on a genuine zero-opportunity day (e.g. a distinct 'ranAndFoundNothing' signal) instead of treating an honest empty array identically to a missing/corrupt file.
